description: Source code for MDIO shell commands in Zephyr RTOS, providing functions for scanning, reading, and writing MDIO devices via shell interface.

methods.name: cmd_mdio_scan
methods.description: Scans the MDIO bus for devices at a specified register address or default 0.

methods.name: cmd_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified port and register address on an MDIO device.

methods.name: cmd_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified port and register address on an MDIO device.

methods.name: cmd_mdio_write_45
methods.description: Performs Clause 45 write operation to an MDIO device.

methods.name: cmd_mdio_read_c45
methods.description: Performs Clause 45 read operation from an MDIO device.
